sentences.zh: 以中書令魏蘭根兼尚書左僕射，為河北行台，定、相、殷三州皆稟蘭根節度。

translations.literal: Minister of the Department of State Affairs Wei Langen was made concurrent Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Hebei Grand Commissioner; the three provinces of Ding, Xiang, and Yin all answered to Lagen's command.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Wei Langen was made concurrent left vice director and Hebei grand commissioner; Ding, Xiang, and Yin provinces fell under his command.

sentences.zh: 爾朱氏兵猶在城下，帝集群臣博議，皆恇懼，不知所出。

translations.literal: Erzhu troops were still below the walls. The Emperor gathered the ministers for wide counsel; all were afraid and knew no way out.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu troops still ringed the walls. The emperor called a council; every minister was afraid and helpless.

sentences.zh: 通直散騎常侍李苗奮衣起曰：「今小賊唐突如此，朝廷有不測之危，正是忠臣烈士效節之日。

translations.literal: Regular Attendant of the Cavalry Li Miao flung his robe aside and rose, saying, "Now these petty bandits are so insolent—the court faces unforeseen peril. This is the day for loyal ministers and heroes to give their lives.
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant Li Miao sprang up: "These bandits insult the throne—the court is in peril. This is the hour for loyal men to die.

sentences.zh: 臣雖不武，請以一旅之眾為陛下徑斷河橋。

translations.literal: Though I am not skilled in arms, I ask to take one command for Your Majesty and cut the River Bridge at a stroke.
translations.idiomatic: I am no warrior, but give me one command and I will cut the River Bridge for Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 」城陽王徽、高道穆皆以為善，帝許之。

translations.literal: " Prince of Chengyang Wei and Gao Daomu all thought it good; the Emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Prince of Chengyang Wei and Gao Daomu approved; the emperor consented.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，苗募人從馬渚上流乘船夜下，去橋數里，縱火船焚河橋，倏忽而至。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Miao recruited men, went upstream from Mazhu in boats by night, and when several li from the bridge set fire-ships to burn the River Bridge. They arrived in an instant.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Miao recruited men, rowed down from Mazhu by night, and when still several li from the bridge sent burning ships against it. They struck like lightning.

sentences.zh: 爾朱氏兵在南岸者，望之，爭橋北度。

translations.literal: Erzhu troops on the south bank, seeing this, all scrambled to cross north over the bridge.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu men on the south bank saw the flames and fought to cross north.

sentences.zh: 俄而橋絕，溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Soon the bridge broke; very many drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The bridge gave way; multitudes drowned.

sentences.zh: 苗將百許人泊於小渚以待南援官軍，不至。

translations.literal: Miao moored a hundred-odd men on a small islet to await the southern relief army from the court; it did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Miao anchored a hundred men on a sandbar to meet the southern relief force—it never came.

sentences.zh: 爾朱氏就擊之，左右皆盡，苗赴水死。

translations.literal: The Erzhu came and attacked them; those at his side were all gone. Miao threw himself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: The Erzhu closed in; his men were killed to the last. Miao threw himself into the river and drowned.

sentences.zh: 帝傷惜之，贈車騎大將軍、儀同三司，封河陽侯，謚曰忠烈。

translations.literal: The Emperor mourned him, posthumously making him Cavalry General-in-Chief and Holder of the Same Rank as the Three Dukes, enfeoffing him as Marquis of Heyang, with posthumous title Loyal and Fierce.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him, posthumously making him cavalry general-in-chief with privilege equal to the Three Dukes, marquis of Heyang, posthumous name Loyal and Fierce.

sentences.zh: 世隆亦收兵北遁。

translations.literal: Shilong also gathered his troops and fled north.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong too gathered his men and fled north.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔行台源子恭將步騎一萬出西道，楊昱將募士八千出東道以討之。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, an edict ordered Mobile Corps Grand Commissioner Yuan Zigong to lead ten thousand foot and horse out the western route and Yang Yu to lead eight thousand levies out the eastern route to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict sent Yuan Zigong with ten thousand foot and horse west and Yang Yu with eight thousand levies east.

sentences.zh: 子恭仍鎮太行丹谷，築壘以防之。

translations.literal: Zigong still guarded Dangu of the Taihang and built fortifications to block them.
translations.idiomatic: Zigong held Dangu in the Taihang and built walls to block them.

sentences.zh: 世隆至建州，刺史陸希質閉城拒守。

translations.literal: Shilong reached Jian province. Inspector Lu Xizhi closed the city and resisted.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong reached Jian province. Inspector Lu Xizhi shut the gates.

sentences.zh: 世隆攻拔之，殺城中人無遺類，以肆其忿，唯希質走免。

translations.literal: Shilong stormed and took it, killed every person in the city without exception to vent his rage; only Xizhi escaped by flight.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong stormed it and slaughtered every soul in the city to vent his rage; only Xizhi escaped.

sentences.zh: 詔以前東荊州刺史元顯恭為晉州刺史，兼尚書左僕射、西道行台。

translations.literal: An edict made former Eastern Jingzhou Inspector Yuan Xiangong Inspector of Jin province, concurrently Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Western Route Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made former Eastern Jingzhou inspector Yuan Xiangong Jinzhou inspector, concurrent left vice director and western-route grand commissioner.

sentences.zh: 魏東徐州刺史廣牧斛斯椿素依附爾朱榮，榮死，椿懼。

translations.literal: Wei's Eastern Xuzhou Inspector, Guangmu Husi Chun, had long attached himself to Erzhu Rong. When Rong died, Chun was afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's Eastern Xuzhou inspector Husi Chun of Guangmu had long served Erzhu Rong. When Rong died, Chun panicked.

sentences.zh: 聞汝南王悅在境上，乃帥部眾棄州歸悅。

translations.literal: Hearing Prince of Runan Yue was on the border, he led his troops, abandoned the province, and went over to Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing Prince of Runan Yue was on the frontier, he abandoned his province and joined Yue.

sentences.zh: 悅授椿侍中、大將軍、司空，封靈丘郡公，又為大行台前驅都督。

translations.literal: Yue made Chun Palace Attendant, Grand General, and Minister of Works, enfeoffed him as Duke of Lingqiu, and also made him vanguard commander of the Grand Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yue made him palace attendant, grand general, and minister of works, duke of Lingqiu, and vanguard of the grand commission.

sentences.zh: 汾州刺史爾朱兆聞榮死，自汾州帥騎據晉陽；

translations.literal: Fenzhou Inspector Erzhu Zhao heard Rong was dead and from Fen province led horse to seize Jinyang;
translations.idiomatic: Fenzhou inspector Erzhu Zhao, hearing Rong was dead, led cavalry from Fenzhou and seized Jinyang;

sentences.zh: 世隆至長子，兆來會之，壬申，共推太原太守、行并州事長廣王曄即皇帝位，大赦，改元建明。

translations.literal: Shilong reached Changzi; Zhao came to join him. On day renshen, together they set up Taiyuan Administrator, Acting Administrator of Bingzhou affairs, Prince of Changuang Ye as emperor, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name to Jianming.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong reached Changzi; Zhao joined him. On renshen they enthroned Taiyuan administrator and acting Bingzhou chief Prince of Changuang Ye, declared amnesty, and proclaimed the Jianming era.

sentences.zh: 曄，英之弟子也。

translations.literal: Ye was a younger cousin of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: Ye was a nephew of Ying.

sentences.zh: 以兆為大將軍，進爵為王；

translations.literal: Zhao was made Grand General and advanced in rank to king;
translations.idiomatic: Zhao was made grand general and promoted to king;

sentences.zh: 世隆為尚書令，賜爵樂平王，加太傅、司州牧。

translations.literal: Shilong was made Minister of the Department of State Affairs, enfeoffed as Prince of Leping, and further made Grand Tutor and Governor of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong became minister of state, prince of Leping, grand tutor, and Sizhou governor.

sentences.zh: 又以榮從弟度律為太尉，賜爵常山王；

translations.literal: Rong's cousin Dulü was also made Grand Marshal and enfeoffed as Prince of Changshan;
translations.idiomatic: Rong's cousin Dulü was made grand marshal and prince of Changshan;

sentences.zh: 世隆兄天柱長史彥伯為侍中；

translations.literal: Shilong's elder brother, Heaven's Pillar's chief clerk Yanbo, was made Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: Shilong's brother Yanbo, chief clerk to Heaven's Pillar, became palace attendant;

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史仲遠為車騎大將軍，兼尚書左僕射、三徐州大行台。

translations.literal: Xuzhou Inspector Zhongyuan was made Cavalry General-in-Chief, concurrently Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Grand Commissioner of the Three Xuzhou provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Xuzhou inspector Zhongyuan became cavalry general-in-chief, concurrent left vice director and grand commissioner of the three Xuzhou provinces.

sentences.zh: 仲遠亦起兵向洛陽。

translations.literal: Zhongyuan also raised troops and marched on Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyuan too raised troops and marched on Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 爾朱天光之克平涼也，宿勤明達請降，既而復叛，北走。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Tianguang had taken Pingliang, Suqin Mingda had asked to surrender, then rebelled again and fled north.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Tianguang took Pingliang, Suqin Mingda had surrendered, then rebelled again and fled north.

sentences.zh: 天光遣賀拔岳討之，明達奔東夏。

translations.literal: Tianguang sent Heba Yue to pursue him. Mingda fled to Eastern Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Tianguang sent Heba Yue after him. Mingda fled to Eastern Xia.

sentences.zh: 岳聞爾朱榮死，不復窮追，還涇州以待天光。

translations.literal: Yue heard Erzhu Rong was dead and did not pursue further, returning to Jingzhou to await Tianguang.
translations.idiomatic: Yue heard Rong was dead, broke off the pursuit, and returned to Jingzhou to await Tianguang.

sentences.zh: 天光與侯莫陳悅亦下隴，與岳謀引兵向洛。

translations.literal: Tianguang and Houmochen Yue also came down from Long and with Yue plotted to lead troops toward Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Tianguang and Houmochen Yue came down from Long and with Yue plotted to march on Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 魏敬宗使朱瑞慰諭天光，天光與岳謀，欲令帝外奔而更立宗室，乃頻啟云：「臣實無異心，唯欲仰奉天顏，以申宗門之罪。

translations.literal: Emperor Jing of Wei sent Zhu Rui to reassure Tianguang. Tianguang and Yue plotted to make the Emperor flee abroad and set up another member of the imperial clan. They repeatedly memorialized: "Your servant truly has no other intent and only wishes to look up to the imperial countenance and declare the clan's guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jing sent Zhu Rui to reassure Tianguang. Tianguang and Yue plotted to drive the emperor abroad and enthrone another prince. They memorialized again and again: "We mean no harm—we only wish to serve the throne and atone for our clan.

sentences.zh: 」又使其下僚屬啟云：「天光密有異圖，願思勝算以防之。

translations.literal: " They also had their subordinate officials memorialize: "Tianguang secretly has other designs. I beg you to consider stratagems to guard against him.
translations.idiomatic: " They also had subordinates warn: "Tianguang plots treason—Your Majesty must guard against him.

sentences.zh: 范陽太守盧文偉誘平州刺史侯淵出獵，閉門拒之。

translations.literal: Fanyang Administrator Lu Wenwei lured Pingzhou Inspector Hou Yuan out to hunt, then shut the gates and refused him.
translations.idiomatic: Fanyang administrator Lu Wenwei lured Pingzhou inspector Hou Yuan out hunting, then shut the gates against him.

sentences.zh: 淵屯於郡南，為榮舉哀，勒兵南向，進至中山，行台僕射魏蘭根邀擊之，為淵所敗。

translations.literal: Yuan encamped south of the commandery, held mourning for Rong, drove his troops south, advanced to Zhongshan. Mobile Corps Vice Director Wei Langen intercepted him and was defeated by Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan camped south of the commandery, mourned Rong, and drove south to Zhongshan. Mobile Corps vice director Wei Langen intercepted him and was beaten.

sentences.zh: 敬宗以城陽王徽兼大司馬、錄尚書事，總統內外。

translations.literal: Jing made Prince of Chengyang Wei concurrent Grand Marshal and Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, commanding inside and outside.
translations.idiomatic: Jing made Prince of Chengyang Wei concurrent grand marshal and recorder of the department of state, commander within and without.

sentences.zh: 徽意謂榮既死，枝葉自應散落，及爾朱世隆等兵四起，黨眾日盛，徽憂怖，不知所出。

translations.literal: Wei supposed that with Rong dead the branches would naturally scatter. When Erzhu Shilong and others raised troops on every side and their faction grew daily, Wei was fearful and knew no way out.
translations.idiomatic: Wei had thought Rong's death would scatter the clan. When Shilong and others rose on every side and their faction swelled, Wei was terrified and helpless.

sentences.zh: 性多忌嫉，不欲人居己前。

translations.literal: By nature he was much given to jealousy and did not wish others to stand before him.
translations.idiomatic: He was jealous by nature and could not bear anyone ahead of him.

sentences.zh: 每獨與帝謀議，群臣有獻策者，徽輒勸帝不納，且曰：「小賊何慮不平！

translations.literal: He always deliberated alone with the Emperor. When ministers offered plans, Wei would urge the Emperor not to adopt them and say, "What worry is there that petty bandits will not be pacified!
translations.idiomatic: He monopolized counsel with the emperor. When ministers offered plans, Wei urged rejection: "Why fear such petty rebels!

sentences.zh: 」又靳惜財貨，賞賜率皆薄少，或多而中減，或與而復追，故徒有糜費而恩不感物。

translations.literal: " He was also stingy with goods and wealth; rewards were generally meager, or if large were cut midway, or if given were pursued and taken back. Therefore there was only waste and no gratitude won.
translations.idiomatic: " He was miserly: rewards were stingy, or promised in full then cut, or given then clawed back—gold spent, loyalty never won.

sentences.zh: 十一月，癸酉朔，敬宗以車騎將軍鄭先護為大都督，與行台楊昱共討爾朱仲遠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the first day guiyou, Jing made Cavalry General-in-Chief Zheng Xianhu Grand Commander, to attack Erzhu Zhongyuan together with Mobile Corps Grand Commissioner Yang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, first day guiyou: Jing made cavalry general-in-chief Zheng Xianhu grand commander, with Yang Yu to attack Erzhu Zhongyuan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以司徒長孫稚為太尉，臨淮王彧為司徒。

translations.literal: On day yihai, Minister of Works Changsun Zhi was made Grand Marshal and Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Yu was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai minister of works Changsun Zhi became grand marshal and Prince of Huaiyang Yuan Yu became minister of works.

sentences.zh: 丙子，進雍州刺史廣宗公爾朱天光爵為王。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Yongzhou Inspector Duke of Guangzong Erzhu Tianguang's noble rank was advanced to king.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Yongzhou inspector Erzhu Tianguang, duke of Guangzong, was promoted to king.

sentences.zh: 長廣王亦以天光為隴西王。

translations.literal: The Prince of Changuang also made Tianguang Prince of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Changuang Ye also made Tianguang prince of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 爾朱仲遠攻西兗州，丁丑，拔之，擒刺史王衍。
衍，蕭之兄子也。
癸未，敬宗以右衛將軍賀拔勝為東征都督。
壬辰，又以鄭先護兼尚書左僕射為行台，與勝共討仲遠。
戊戌，詔罷魏蘭根行台，以定州刺史薛曇尚兼尚書，為北道行台。
鄭先護疑賀拔勝，置之營外。
庚子，勝與仲遠戰於滑台東，兵敗，降於仲遠。
初，爾朱榮嘗從容問左右曰：「一日無我，誰可主軍？
」皆稱爾朱兆。
榮曰：「兆雖勇於戰鬥，然所將不過三千騎，多則亂矣。
堪代我者，唯賀六渾耳。
」因戒兆曰：「爾非其匹，終當為其穿鼻。
」乃以高歡為晉州刺史。
及兆引兵向洛，遣使召歡，歡遣長史孫騰詣兆，辭以「山蜀未平，今方攻討，不可委去，致有後憂。
定蜀之日，當隔河為犄角之勢。
」兆不悅，曰：「還白高晉州，吾得吉夢，夢與吾先人登高丘，丘旁之地，耕之已熟，獨餘馬藺，先人命吾拔之，隨手而盡。
以此觀之，往無不克。
」騰還報，歡曰：「兆狂愚如是，而敢為悖逆，吾勢不得久事爾朱矣。
十二月，壬寅朔，爾朱兆攻丹谷，都督崔伯鳳戰死，都督史仵龍開壁請降，源子恭退走。
兆輕兵倍道兼行，從河橋西涉渡。
先是，敬宗以大河深廣，謂兆未能猝濟，是日，水不沒馬腹。
甲辰，暴風，黃塵漲天，兆騎叩宮門，宿衛乃覺，彎弓欲射，矢不得發，一時散走。
華山王鷙，斤之玄孫也，素附爾朱氏。
帝始聞兆南下，欲自帥諸軍討之，鷙說帝曰：「黃河萬仞，兆安得渡！
」帝遂自安。
及兆入宮，鷙復約止衛兵不使鬥。
帝步出雲龍門外，遇城陽王徽乘馬走，帝屢呼之，不顧而去。
兆騎執帝，鎖於永寧寺樓上。
帝寒甚，就兆求頭巾，不與。
兆營於尚書省，用天子金鼓，設刻漏於庭，撲殺皇子，污辱嬪御妃主，縱兵大掠，殺司空臨淮王彧、尚書左僕射范陽王誨、青州刺史李延寔等。
城陽王徽走至山南，抵前洛陽令寇祖仁家。
祖仁一門三刺史，皆徽所引拔，以有舊恩，故投之。
徽繼金百斤，馬五十匹，祖仁利其財，外雖容納，而私謂子弟曰：「如聞爾朱兆購募城陽王，得之者封千戶侯，今日富貴至矣！
」乃怖徽雲官捕將至，令其逃於它所，使人於路邀殺之，送首於兆；
兆亦不加勳賞。
兆夢徽謂己曰：「我有金二百斤、馬百匹在祖仁家，卿可取之。
」兆既覺，意所夢為實，即掩捕祖仁，征其金、馬。
祖仁謂人密告，望風款服，云「實得金百斤、馬五十匹。
」兆疑其隱匿，依夢征之，祖仁家舊有金三十斤、馬三十匹，盡以輸兆，兆猶不信，發怒，執祖仁，懸首高樹，大石墜足，捶之至死。
爾朱世隆至洛陽，兆自以為己功，責世隆曰：「叔父在朝日久，耳目應廣，如何令天柱受禍！
」按劍瞋目，聲色甚厲。
世隆遜辭拜謝，然後得已，由是深恨之。
爾朱仲遠亦自滑台至洛。
戊申，魏長廣王大赦。
爾朱榮之死也，敬宗詔河西賊帥紇豆陵步蕃使襲秀容。
及兆入洛，步蕃南下，兵勢甚盛，故兆不暇久留，亟還晉陽以御之，使爾朱世隆、度律、彥伯等留鎮洛陽。
甲寅，兆遷敬宗於晉陽，兆自於河梁監閱財資。
高歡聞敬宗向晉陽，帥騎東巡，欲邀之，不及。
因與兆書，為陳禍福，不宜害天子，受惡名；
兆怒，不納。
爾朱天光輕騎入洛，見世隆等，即還雍州。
初，敬宗恐北軍不利，欲為南走之計，托雲征蠻，以高道穆為南道大行台，未及發而兆入洛。
道穆托疾去，世隆殺之。
主者請追李苗封贈，世隆曰：「當時眾議，更一二日即欲縱兵大掠，焚燒郭邑，賴苗之故，京師獲全。
天下之善一也，不宜復追。
爾朱榮之死也，世隆等徵兵於大寧太守代人房謨。
謨不應，前後斬其三使，遣弟毓詣洛陽。
及兆得志，其黨建州刺史是蘭安定執謨系州獄，郡中蜀人聞之，皆叛。
安定給謨弱馬，令軍前慰勞。
諸賊見謨，莫不遙拜。
謨先所乘馬，安定別給將士。
戰敗，蜀人得之，謂謨遇害，莫不悲泣，善養其馬，不聽人乘之。
兒童婦女競投草粟，皆言此房公馬也。
爾朱世隆聞之，捨其罪，以為其府長史。
北道大行台楊津，以眾少，留鄴召募，欲自滏口入并州，會爾朱兆入洛，津乃散眾，輕騎還朝。
爾朱世隆與兄弟密謀，慮長廣王母衛氏干預朝政，伺其出行，遣數十騎如劫盜者於京巷殺之，尋懸榜以千萬錢募賊。
甲子，爾朱兆縊敬宗於晉陽三級佛寺，並殺陳留王寬。
是月，紇豆陵步蕃大破爾朱兆於秀容，南逼晉陽。
兆懼，使人召高歡並力。
僚屬皆勸歡勿應召，歡曰：「兆方急，保無它慮。
」遂行。
歡所親賀拔焉過兒請緩行以弊之，歡往往逗留，辭以河無橋，不得渡。
步蕃兵日盛，兆屢敗，告急於歡，歡乃往從之。
兆時避步蕃南出，步蕃至平樂郡，歡與兆進兵合擊，大破之，斬步蕃於石鼓山，其眾退走。
兆德歡，相與誓為兄弟，將數十騎詣歡，通夜宴飲。
初，葛榮部眾流入並、肆者二十餘萬，為契胡陵暴，皆不聊生，大小二十六反，誅夷者半，猶謀亂不止。
兆患之，問計於歡，歡曰：「六鎮反殘，不可盡殺，宜選王腹心使統之，有犯者罪其帥，則所罪者寡矣。
」兆曰：「善！
誰可使者？
」賀拔允時在坐，請使歡領之。
歡拳毆其口，折一齒，曰：「平生天柱時，奴輩伏處分如鷹犬。
今日天下事取捨在王，而阿鞠泥敢僭易妄言，請殺之！
」兆以歡為誠，遂以其眾委焉。
歡以兆醉，恐醒而悔之，遂出，宣言：「受委統州鎮兵，可集汾東受號令。
」乃建牙陽曲川，陳部分。
軍士素惡兆而樂屬歡，莫不皆至。
居無何，又使劉貴請兆，以「並、肆頻歲霜旱，降戶掘田鼠而食之，面無谷色，徒污人境內，請令就食山東，待溫飽更受處分。
」兆從其議。
長史慕容紹宗諫曰：「不可。
方今四方紛擾，人懷異望，高公雄才蓋世，復使握大兵於外，譬如借蛟龍以雲雨，將不可制矣。
」兆曰：「有香火重誓，何慮邪！
」紹宗曰：「親兄弟尚不可信，何論香火！
」時兆左右已受歡金，因稱紹宗與歡有舊隙。
兆怒，囚紹宗，趣歡發。
歡自晉陽出滏口，道逢北鄉長公主自洛陽來，有馬三百匹，盡奪而易之。
兆聞之，乃釋紹宗而問之，紹宗曰：「此猶是掌握中物也。
」兆乃自追歡，至襄垣，會漳水暴漲，橋壞，歡隔水拜曰：「所以借公主馬，非有它故，備山東盜耳。
王信公主之讒，自來賜追，今不辭渡水而死，恐此眾便叛。
」兆自陳無此意，因輕馬渡水，與歡坐幕下陳謝，授歡刀，引頸使歡斫之。
歡大哭曰：「自天柱之薨，賀六渾更何所仰！
但願大家千萬歲，以申力用耳。
今為旁人所構間，大家何忍復出此言！
」兆投刀於地，復斬白馬，與歡為誓，因留宿夜飲。
尉景伏壯士欲執兆，歡嚙臂止之，曰：「今殺之，其黨必奔歸聚結；
兵饑馬瘦，不可與敵。
若英雄乘之而起，則為害滋甚。
不如且置之，兆雖驍勇，凶悍無謀，不足圖也。
」旦日，兆歸營，復召歡，歡將上馬詣之，孫騰牽歡衣，歡乃止。
兆隔水肆罵，馳還晉陽。
兆腹心念賢領降戶家屬別為營，歡偽與之善，觀其佩刀，因取殺之。
士眾感悅，益願附從。
齊州城民趙洛周聞爾朱兆入洛，逐刺史丹楊王蕭贊，以城歸兆。
贊變形為沙門，逃入長白山，流轉，卒於陽平。
梁人或盜其柩以歸，上猶以子禮葬於陵次。
魏荊州刺史李琰之，韶之族弟也。
南陽太守趙修延，以琰之敬宗外族，誣琰之欲奔梁，發兵襲州城，執琰之，自行州事。
魏王悅改元更興，聞爾朱兆已入洛，自知不及事，遂南還。
斛斯椿復棄悅奔魏。
是歲，詔以陳慶之為都督南、北司等四州諸軍事、南、北司二州刺史。
慶之引兵圍魏懸瓠，破魏穎州刺史婁起等於溱水，又破行台孫騰等於楚城。
罷義陽鎮兵，停水陸漕運，江、湖諸州並得休息；
開田六十頃，二年之後，倉廩充實。
